Native Canvas Interaction
|-- Mount boundary: MappingEditorCanvas(session)
|   |-- CanvasSession.controller supplies semantic state and checkpoint history
|   |-- One CanvasRuntime per session -> connect controller subscription
|   |-- Tldraw Editor + MappingEditorRuntime + shared gesture ownership
|   |   `-- Editor owns live shape geometry and native undo navigation
|   |-- Application controls retain pointer and keyboard handling
|   |   |-- Semantic Delete -> controller.applyUpdate(delete-diagrams)
|   |   `-- Paste uses application ASCII/source-aware commands
|   `-- Camera stays outside semantic gesture commits
|       |-- Camera reactor -> overlay DOM transform; no application React state
|       |-- Changed camera on tick -> captureViewCamera + transform callback
|       `-- Revision change with saved viewport -> restore Editor camera
|-- MappingEditorRuntime: semantic state <-> native shapes
|   |-- Controller snapshot -> projectMappingShapes -> Editor
|   |   |-- Grid boxes -> parent-relative pixel positions, sizes, revision IDs
|   |   |-- Visible floating nodes -> positions and bounds
|   |   |   `-- Collapsed/docked conversation -> 36x36 bubble at canvasAnchor
|   |   |-- Edges + side panels -> locked shapes, brought to front
|   |   `-- Diff projection -> create/update/delete shapes + reconcile selection
|   |-- Publish on relevant controller changes
|   |   |-- Same checkpoint while pointing -> defer projection
|   |   |-- New checkpoint -> record shapes and checkpoint reference together
|   |   `-- syncing / settling / navigating guards prevent feedback loops
|   |-- Native shape or selection changes -> dirty flag
|   |   `-- Tick waits until no pointing, dragging or pinching
|   |       |-- Settle native geometry before pending projection
|   |       |-- Grid movement -> page bounds -> rounded, nonnegative cell position
|   |       |-- Supported diagram clone -> duplicate-instance with fresh ID
|   |       |   `-- Unsupported clones -> remove temporary native copies
|   |       |-- Floating movement/resize -> display geometry
|   |       |   |-- Manual placement; resized bounds use fixed sizing
|   |       |   `-- Collapsed conversation movement also updates canvasAnchor
|   |       `-- Moves or display changes -> controller.commitEditorGesture
|   |           `-- Durable semantic change occurs at settlement, not pointer frames
|   `-- Selection ownership protects application meaning
|       |-- Application selection change -> claim application ownership
|       |-- Native selection supplies extra diagram IDs for dragging
|       |-- Content membership changes through explicit application gestures
|       `-- Pending projection suppresses native selection capture
|-- Native history <-> controller checkpoint archive
|   |-- Hydrate Editor history with checkpoint references
|   |   |-- Replay past + head + future; undo back to head
|   |   `-- Materialize current shapes only; historical geometry loads on navigation
|   |-- Store mappingCheckpoint in document metadata with the shape diff
|   |-- undo/redo -> complete interaction -> settle -> Editor undo/redo
|   |   `-- Canvas transfer transaction -> require workspace undo/redo
|   `-- Synchronous document change observer sees a different checkpoint
|       `-- controller.restoreEditorCheckpoint(id) -> publish without recording
|-- CanvasRuntime: renderer-local state and services
|   |-- Controller snapshot -> grids, floats, panels, alternatives and edges
|   |   |-- Per-ID atoms + shareEqual preserve unchanged model branches
|   |   |-- Skip sync when document/display/views/selection/cell are unchanged
|   |   `-- Grid layoutKey includes revision, ASCII hash, view, cell,
|   |       collapsed state and selected alternative
|   |-- Connection focus uses revision-scoped content nodes
|   |   |-- focusNode validates current revision and content-node membership
|   |   |-- nodeConnections matches display ID + content ID + revision ID
|   |   `-- Removed edge, changed node revision or selection -> clear stale focus
|   |-- resolveAnchor -> endpoint rectangle relative to owning grid
|   |   `-- LocalAnchorStore: per-endpoint atoms keyed by identity
|   |       |-- Read measurement only when layoutKey matches
|   |       |-- Round measurements to 0.01; skip equal writes
|   |       |-- Changed layout/font load -> invalidate; removed owner -> drop record
|   |       `-- Camera movement and DOM culling preserve measurements
|   `-- routedEdges -> nativeEdgeInput -> NativeRoutingStore.drawAll
|       |-- Obstacles belong to grid models
|       |   |-- Matching measured layout -> measured local obstacles
|       |   |-- Otherwise -> obstacles derived from diagram content/view/cell
|       |   `-- Editor shape page transform -> world-space obstacle bounds
|       |-- During drag -> previewEdge using last settled route
|       |-- After drag -> route current inputs + obstacles
|       |   |-- Matching completed job -> reuse settled arrows
|       |   |-- Worker available -> queue latest request; show preview meanwhile
|       |   |   |-- One job in flight; retain only newest pending job
|       |   |   `-- Publish result only if it matches the latest requested key
|       |   `-- No worker / worker failure -> synchronous ConnectionRouter
|       |-- ConnectionRouter: pure cache shared with headless callers
|       |   |-- Per-edge reuse requires same edge/endpoints/geometry source
|       |   |   `-- Relevant obstacle geometry near previous route must also match
|       |   |-- drawAll -> route edges -> space lanes -> cache arrow map
|       |   `-- retain -> discard routes for removed edges
|       `-- Routing has no DOM reads, document writes or camera dependencies
`-- Unmount / detach
    |-- MappingEditorRuntime.dispose -> complete + settle, then unsubscribe
    |-- Remove camera tick, font and pointer listeners; unregister selection tools
    |-- Disconnect CanvasRuntime controller subscription
    `-- Clear runtime Editor -> dispose routing worker, jobs and settled results
